text: Amway Vietnam opens new business support centre in Bắc Ninh

BẮC NINH - Amway Vietnam, a global health and beauty company, has officially inaugurated a new Business Support Centre, known as Amway Mini Center, at 151 Hùng Vương Street, Bắc Giang Ward, Bắc Ninh City.

The opening marks another milestone in the company's long-term investment strategy in Việt Nam, aimed at strengthening its operational infrastructure, improving service quality and providing greater convenience for distributors and consumers.

The new centre underscores Amway Vietnam's continued commitment to expanding its presence across the country and improving access to its products, services and business support activities for local distributors and consumers.
Designed as a multifunctional space, the Bắc Ninh Mini Centre allows customers to explore and experience Amway's product portfolio, covering health, nutrition, beauty and home care.

It also provides distributors with a professional and modern environment for training sessions, meetings, consultations and business development activities, in line with the company's global brand standards.

The Mini Centre model has also been rolled out in cooperation with Vietnam Post (VNPost) in several other locations, including Hồ Chí Minh City (formerly the Bình Dương area), Đồng Tháp, Đà Nẵng, An Giang and Vinh.
The partnership is intended to expand Amway's service network, bring the brand closer to consumers and improve logistics efficiency, helping reduce delivery times.
Combining business expansion with community engagement
Alongside its business development activities, Amway Vietnam continues to emphasise its social responsibility and contribution to local communities.
As part of the opening ceremony, the company donated VND100 million to the Fund for the Poor in Bắc Giang Ward to support local social welfare programmes and assist disadvantaged people.

Commenting on the company's strategy to expand its business support centre network, Hùynh Thiên Triều, General Director of Amway Vietnam, said the opening of the Bắc Ninh facility reflected the company's long-term commitment to investing in the Vietnamese market.

Amway aims to provide distributors with convenient spaces to connect, acquire knowledge and develop their businesses, while enabling consumers to access and experience the company's products more easily, according to Triều.

Beyond improving service quality, Amway Vietnam remains committed to supporting local communities through meaningful initiatives that generate positive social impacts and contribute to sustainable development. - VNS
